_comment: SEAC4RS (2013, NASA DC-8) family map; longest-prefix match of column names. PI-Neph GRASP retrievals and DASH-SP growth factors get their own families (independent retrievals kept under /observations, not used by the ISARA fit).

family_long_name.optical: In-situ aerosol optical measurements (TSI-3563 nephelometer, PSAP; NOAA CRDS extinction)
family_long_name.aerosol_size_dist: In-situ dry aerosol size distributions (SMPS, TSI LAS [PSL], DMT UHSAS [AmmSO4], TSI APS [PSL])
family_long_name.aerosol_composition: In-situ aerosol composition (AMS 60 s, SAGA bulk ions, HDSP2 black carbon)
family_long_name.ccn: Cloud condensation nuclei concentrations (LARGE CCN counter)
family_long_name.pineph_retrievals: PI-Neph GRASP retrievals: PSD, complex refractive index, SSA, sphericity (independent of the ISARA retrieval)
